fine_lines.title: hope vs wish
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hope لشيء ممكن الحدوث في المستقبل: I hope it helps. wish لشيء غير حقيقي الآن أو غير ممكن، وبعده فعل ماضٍ أو could: I wish I could (لكنني لا أستطيع).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use hope for something possible: I hope it helps. Use wish for something not true now or not possible, with a past form or could: I wish I could (but I can't).

examples.sentence: I hope I have time to see everything.
I wish I could, but I can't.
I wish I had more time.

fine_lines.title: look at vs stare at
fine_lines.explanation_ar: look at = ينظر إلى، stare at = يحدّق لفترة طويلة دون أن يحرّك عينيه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Look at = turn your eyes to something. Stare at = look for a long time without moving your eyes.

examples.sentence: He stared at the screen all day.

grammar.title: Hope and wish
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) hope + مضارع أو will: لشيء ممكن في المستقبل (I hope it helps). 2) hope + to + فعل (المصدر): لشيء تريد أن تفعله مستقبلًا (I hope to visit Peru one day). 3) wish + ماضٍ أو could: لشيء غير حقيقي الآن تتمنى أن يكون مختلفًا (I wish I could join you = لا أستطيع الانضمام). 4) I wish! وحدها تعني «يا ليت!».
grammar.explanation_en: 1) hope + present/will for something possible (I hope it helps). 2) hope + to + verb for a future plan (I hope to visit Peru one day). 3) wish + past or could for something not true now (I wish I could join you = I can't). 4) 'I wish!' alone means 'I want that, but it won't happen.'
examples: I hope it helps with your story.
I hope to visit Peru one day.
I wish I could join you, but I have work to do.
I wish I could do art like that.
